newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB O/N repo average yields top 44 percent.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB O/N repo average yields top 44 percent.

text.p: Average yields in the Czech National Bank's (CNB) three overnight repo tenders held on Tuesday were just below the set limit of 45 percent, the CNB said.
The average yield for the overnight repo due on May 21 was 44.58 percent, while the May 22 repo averaged 44.45 percent, and the May 23 repo averaged 44.14 percent.
All bids at the maximum 45 percent were accepted in all three tenders, but the central bank did not release the volumes of the transactions.
